title: A scientific note on pollinators’ ability to overcome exploitation barriers: deep hummingbird-evolved corollas and small-sized bees
decision_basis: The frozen contract requires a recoverable quantitative comparison/model linking an independently measured access-geometry variable to robbery route use. The publisher identifies this as a field-observation scientific note and states that supporting data are within the paywalled article and rough numbers are available only on request. Publisher PDF/article URLs returned an HTML access wrapper in the reproducible GitHub-runner audit; the institutional repository exposes only a restricted publisher PDF. Public companion evidence establishes the deep-corolla/small-bee mechanism context but does not recover the required within-study quantitative geometry-to-robbery relation.
notes: Fail-closed evidence-recoverability exclusion, not a claim that the biological mechanism is absent. Relevant mechanistic context remains citable outside the formal finite-frame denominator.
